# HexPiece 2.6.8

A diagnostic build for the flicker and lag when you draw or sheathe with Haki on. Nothing else changed.

- **Please:** turn Haki on, draw and sheathe a few times in first person until it lags, then quit and send `logs/latest.log`.
  Lines starting with "HexPiece first person" show what the sword view was drawing, once a second, and any error it hit. That
  will show the real cause.
